blockingFindings.description: After the V172 increase in native Cloth bending stiffness, direct front/back/side/three-quarter inspection still shows heavily crumpled angular overskirt folds, unequal side lift and collapse, and stacked lilac hem bands on both side profiles. The solver adjustment does not yield a continuous, balanced skirt edge.

Irregular gray body-colored patches remain visible across the white chest and waist in neutral, arms-up and arm-cross renders. Current renders do not isolate whether these are intersections, exposed source surfaces, or shading; the cause remains unresolved.
In crouch and sit, both shorts-clad thighs visibly project in front of the overskirt while the center front panel falls behind them. Coverage and clearance remain unacceptable in bent-leg poses.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
